messages.subject: Lavaan warning message: "The variance-covariance matrix ..."
parts:
Hi,

I recently tried a GWIS model GWAS as Elliott suggested me earlier in the issue I raised in the github page. The model worked and I have two warnings in the resulting summary file. First one is "estimation of the baseline model failed", which can be ignored according to github page tutorials. The second warning is "The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov) does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigen value (=1.00000e-16) is close to zero. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified". Can I ignore the second warning as well?

Regards
Veera
